decoding.two_stage_escalation: see Q-3 rule; k may become 2 only under the pre-registered escalation band

why_not_greedy: DeepSeek explicitly warns that greedy decoding induces repetition degeneration in R1-Distill models. Greedy would therefore manufacture a failure mode in the arm most susceptible to it, which is exactly the arm this phase is measuring.

seed_rule.why_the_seed_does_not_depend_on_conditio: This is common random numbers, and it is deliberate rather than an oversight. The same item draws the same seed under T, H and F, so the sampling noise is shared across arms and differences out of the item-paired contrast. Seeding per condition would inject independent noise into every arm and inflate the variance of exactly the paired difference this phase exists to estimate.

trust_remote_code.adapter_exception_basis: authority 4.2 records that the adapter requires its own Qwen2ForCausalLMWithTranscoder class; this is the single registered exception and it applies to no other model

scoring.equivalence: frozen symbolic checker, version pinned in the container image

length_tolerance_for_Q3.criterion: median completed length of F must be at least 0.70 x the median completed length of T
length_tolerance_for_Q3.applies_to: completed responses only, meaning responses that reached EOS rather than the generation ceiling
length_tolerance_for_Q3.why_median_not_mean: completion length is heavy tailed, so a mean is dominated by a handful of long responses and would not describe the typical response
length_tolerance_for_Q3.why_completed_only: including ceiling-truncated responses would censor the very quantity being compared and would make the statistic depend on the ceiling rather than on the model
length_tolerance_for_Q3.rationale: Authority Q-3 requires that F not shorten responses relative to T beyond a pre-registered tolerance. A materially shorter F would indicate the adapter has damaged the reasoning process rather than recovered it, and an accuracy figure obtained from truncated reasoning would not mean what it appears to mean.
length_tolerance_for_Q3.direction: one sided; F being LONGER than T is not a Q-3 failure
length_tolerance_for_Q3.why_one_sided: the registered concern is damage that shortens reasoning; a longer response is not evidence of that damage and is reported descriptively

recorded_per_arm_alongside_accuracy: completion length distribution including p50 and p99
parser false-negative rate on development items with known answers
claim_ceiling: This contract fixes how measurements are taken. Nothing in it, and no number produced under it, is evidence about J-space, about distillation, or about reasoning.
